records.title: Bitnomial Clearinghouse accepted collateral, member list and margin schedule
records.note: Bitnomial Clearinghouse identifies itself as a CFTC-registered DCO. Its page lists Hidden Road Partners CIV US LLC among clearing members; accepted collateral XRP at a 40% haircut and $15M notional limit; XRP product maintenance margin entries XRPUH, XRPUS, XRUH and XRUY at 17%. The 40% collateral haircut and 17% product maintenance margin are distinct controls. Listing establishes acceptance/rules, not actual deposits or utilization.

records.title: Bitnomial XRP US Dollar Hecto Futures specification
records.note: XRUH contract size 100 XRP; USD per XRP quotation; USD margin; 23/5 market hours; deliverable settlement under rulebook Chapter 11; position limit 600,000 contracts and reportable position level 25 contracts. Product specification does not disclose current open interest or trading volume.

records.title: Bitnomial XRP US Dollar Perpetual Futures specification
records.note: PXRPUS reportable contract size 10,000 XRP, minimum 1 XRP; 24/7 market; cash-settled; settlement index is CF XRP Mid-Price Spot Rate. Product specification is distinct from deliverable XRUH futures and does not disclose current positions or utilization.

records.title: Bitnomial digital-asset perpetual pricing and funding methodology
records.note: Perpetual funding is calculated every eight hours; contracts settle to the index at each funding interval; when funding is positive, longs pay shorts, and when negative, shorts pay longs. This is Bitnomial's methodology, not a market observation of current XRP funding.

records.title: CFTC digital-assets collateral pilot scope
records.note: CFTC's December 8, 2025 release describes a no-action pilot for FCMs accepting non-securities digital-asset margin collateral. During the initial three-month period eligible digital assets are limited to BTC, ETH and USDC. XRP is not named in that pilot announcement. This FCM no-action pilot is distinct from Bitnomial Clearinghouse's venue-specific DCO collateral schedule.

records.title: Ripple closes Hidden Road acquisition; Hidden Road becomes Ripple Prime
records.note: Ripple says the acquisition closed October 24, 2025 and Hidden Road became Ripple Prime. Ripple reports RLUSD is used as collateral for a number of prime-brokerage products and some derivatives customers elected to hold RLUSD balances. This is company-reported RLUSD use; it does not establish XRP collateral deposits at Bitnomial.

records.title: Ripple Prime launches US institutional digital-asset spot prime brokerage
records.note: Ripple announced US institutional OTC spot execution across dozens of digital assets including XRP and RLUSD. It states clients can cross-margin OTC spot transactions and holdings with the rest of their digital-asset portfolio, including OTC swaps and CME futures/options. This describes Ripple Prime's offering, not measured client balances or realized XRP volume.
